title: Sampling and reconstruction of convex functions
summary: We discuss optimal recovery for classes of multivariate convex functions from given point samples, as well as the sampling numbers of these classes, corresponding to optimal sample choices. Upper and lower bounds for either variant are established when the reconstruction error is measured in $L_p$ for $1\leq p\leq \infty$. These bounds match, sometimes up to logarithmic factors, and therefore characterize the respective optimal rate of decay.
